description: This file declares utility functions for extracting various data types (uint64, int64, int, string, bool, double) from XML nodes, using the libxml2 library. It appears to be part of an XML parsing helper module specifically for the icrule component within the Zilker SDK.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_uint64
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned 64-bit integer value from an XML node and property.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_int64
methods.description: Retrieves a signed 64-bit integer value from an XML node and property.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_int
methods.description: Retrieves a signed 32-bit integer value from an XML node and property.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_string
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from an XML node and property, caller must free the returned string.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from an XML node and property.

methods.name: icrule_get_xml_double
methods.description: Retrieves a double floating-point value from an XML node and property.
